value_and_limitation_analysis.how_metadata_helps_scoping: Attaching `year` (2017, 2018, 2019, 2021) and `task_domain` (`question_answering`, `dialogue`, `summarization`) to every chunk payload allows Strategy C to push exact equality predicates down to the vector store before similarity ranking. On `q18` (`year=2019, task_domain=dialogue`), filtering restricts the candidate pool from 232 total chunks down to only the 37 chunks of `reddit-2019` (a 84.1% search-space reduction). On `q20` (`year=2018, task_domain=summarization`), filtering restricts the search space from 232 chunks down to the 23 chunks of `wikihow-2018` (a 90.1% reduction), preventing cross-contamination from CNN/DailyMail discussions in `searchqa-2017` (`year=2017, task_domain=question_answering`).
value_and_limitation_analysis.concrete_limitation_observed: Heuristic regex-based `section` detection in two-column academic PDFs can misassign a floating table caption as the active section header when a paragraph continues across columns above or below a table. Specifically, in Strategy B and C on `q16` rank 1 (`B:gooaq-2021:p08:c003` and `C:gooaq-2021:p08:c003`), the text belongs to Section `5.3 Extrinsic Utility of GOOAQ`, but because `Table 2: Error distribution for the two models` appears at the top of page 8 (`p08:c002`), the state machine labeled `section` as `"Table 2: Error distribution for the two models"` for 2/15 test records (`p08:c002` and `p08:c003`). Additionally, chunks at the top of a page before the first section heading receive the fallback label `"Page_Header_or_Body"` (6/15 records).
